answer_1.quote: We use 's adaptive attention model. The model's encoder uses a pre-trained CNN to represent images as feature vectors (we used ResNet152). A single LSTM layer with rectifier activation transforms the feature vectors into new vectors v g . We concatenate the vector v g with the word embedding vector w t as the input for the decoder.

answer_2.quote: We assess the quality of generated captions in terms of CIDEr scores , measuring the overlap with human captions. Since our model generates captions character by character, we report the absolute number of out-of-vocabulary types and tokens (OOV types and tokens)... We measure diversity using different type-token ratios (TTR).
